welcome.pitch: The AI-native workspace that turns you into a creative all-rounder. Never break your flow again.
options.title: Make it yours
options.subtitle: Defaults are sane. Change what you want.
options.startmenu: Add Somnia to the Start menu
options.assoc: Open web and media files with Somnia (.html, .svg, .md, .somnia)
progress.title: Setting up Somnia
progress.step.assoc: Teaching Windows about your file types
update.title: Update to Somnia {version}
update.body: We'll swap in the new version. Your projects, settings and extensions stay exactly where they are.
finish.title: You're in.
finish.body: Somnia {version} is ready. Open a folder and make something.
cancel.pre.title: Leave already?
cancel.pre.body: Nothing was installed. You can come back any time.
cancel.mid.title: Stop the installation?
cancel.mid.body: We'll clean up the half-finished files. Your system stays as it was.
cancelled.title: Installation cancelled
cancelled.body: Somnia wasn't installed and no changes were made to your PC. You can start again anytime.
error.download.body: We couldn't download the installation files. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.disk.body: Somnia needs {required} of free space on {drive}, but only {free} is available. Free up space, then retry.
error.permission.body: We can't write to {path}. Pick a folder you own, or run the installer as administrator.
error.running.body: Close Somnia and we'll keep going right where we stopped.
error.corrupt.body: The download didn't survive the trip. Grab a fresh copy from somnia.philipp-paulik.de.
error.leftover.body: A previous installation left files behind. We can remove them and continue.
error.webview2.body: Somnia's installer needs Microsoft WebView2. Install it, then run the installer again.
error.generic.body: Something broke on our side, not yours. The log has the details if you want them.
field.notabsolute: Use a full path, for example C:\Users\you\Somnia.
field.unwritable: We can't write to that folder. Pick another one.
